name: GoodHabitz
verdict: Majority-owned by Prosus N.V., which is in turn majority-owned by Naspers. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Dutch online-training provider, PSV's back-of-shirt sponsor since the 2018-19 season and extended in January 2024 by two seasons. Majority stake held by Prosus (Euronext: PRX) since 2021; Naspers (JSE: NPN) holds 56.92% of Prosus. Both listed companies; no state or fund ownership found and no sourced abuse record.
